{"type": "text", "text": "Base directory for this skill: /logs/agent/sessions/skills/data-visualization

# Data Visualization Skill

Chart selection guidance, Python visualization code patterns, design principles, and accessibility considerations for creating effective data visualizations.

## Chart Selection Guide

### Choose by Data Relationship

| What You're Showing | Best Chart | Alternatives |
|---|---|---|
| **Trend over time** | Line chart | Area chart (if showing cumulative or composition) |
| **Comparison across categories** | Vertical bar chart | Horizontal bar (many categories), lollipop chart |
| **Ranking** | Horizontal bar chart | Dot plot, slope chart (comparing two periods) |
| **Part-to-whole composition** | Stacked bar chart | Treemap (hierarchical), waffle chart |
| **Composition over time** | Stacked area chart | 100% stacked bar (for proportion focus) |
| **Distribution** | Histogram | Box plot (comparing groups), violin plot, strip plot |
| **Correlation (2 variables)** | Scatter plot | Bubble chart (add 3rd variable as size) |
| **Correlation (many variables)** | Heatmap (correlation matrix) | Pair plot |
| **Geographic patterns** | Choropleth map | Bubble map, hex map |
| **Flow / process** | Sankey diagram | Funnel chart (sequential stages) |
| **Relationship network** | Network graph | Chord diagram |
| **Performance vs. target** | Bullet chart | Gauge (single KPI only) |
| **Multiple KPIs at once** | Small multiples | Dashboard with separate charts |

### When NOT to Use Certain Charts

- **Pie charts**: Avoid unless <6 categories and exact proportions matter less than rough comparison. Humans are bad at comparing angles. Use bar charts instead.
- **3D charts**: Never. They distort perception and add no information.
- **Dual-axis charts**: Use cautiously. They can mislead by implying correlation. Clearly label both axes if used.
- **Stacked bar (many categories)**: Hard to compare middle segments. Use small multiples or grouped bars instead.
- **Donut charts**: Slightly better than pie charts but same fundamental issues. Use for single KPI display at most.

## Python Visualization Code Patterns

### Setup and Style

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Professional style setup
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
plt.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (10, 6),
    'figure.dpi': 150,
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 14,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.titlesize': 16,
})

# Colorblind-friendly palettes
PALETTE_CATEGORICAL = ['#4C72B0', '#DD8452', '#55A868', '#C44E52', '#8172B3', '#937860']
PALETTE_SEQUENTIAL = 'YlOrRd'
PALETTE_DIVERGING = 'RdBu_r'
```

### Line Chart (Time Series)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

for label, group in df.groupby('category'):
    ax.plot(group['date'], group['value'], label=label, linewidth=2)

ax.set_title('Metric Trend by Category', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Value')
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Format dates on x-axis
fig.autofmt_xdate()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('trend_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Bar Chart (Comparison)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Sort by value for easy reading
df_sorted = df.sort_values('metric', ascending=True)

bars = ax.barh(df_sorted['category'], df_sorted['metric'], color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[0])

# Add value labels
for bar in bars:
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax.text(width + 0.5, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            f'{width:,.0f}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=10)

ax.set_title('Metric by Category (Ranked)', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Metric Value')
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('bar_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Histogram (Distribution)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

ax.hist(df['value'], bins=30, color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[0], edgecolor='white', alpha=0.8)

# Add mean and median lines
mean_val = df['value'].mean()
median_val = df['value'].median()
ax.axvline(mean_val, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'Mean: {mean_val:,.1f}')
ax.axvline(median_val, color='green', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'Median: {median_val:,.1f}')

ax.set_title('Distribution of Values', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Value')
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax.legend()
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('histogram.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Heatmap

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))

# Pivot data for heatmap format
pivot = df.pivot_table(index='row_dim', columns='col_dim', values='metric', aggfunc='sum')

sns.heatmap(pivot, annot=True, fmt=',.0f', cmap='YlOrRd',
            linewidths=0.5, ax=ax, cbar_kws={'label': 'Metric Value'})

ax.set_title('Metric by Row Dimension and Column Dimension', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Column Dimension')
ax.set_ylabel('Row Dimension')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('heatmap.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Small Multiples

```python
categories = df['category'].unique()
n_cats = len(categories)
n_cols = min(3, n_cats)
n_rows = (n_cats + n_cols - 1) // n_cols

fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_rows, n_cols, figsize=(5*n_cols, 4*n_rows), sharex=True, sharey=True)
axes = axes.flatten() if n_cats > 1 else [axes]

for i, cat in enumerate(categories):
    ax = axes[i]
    subset = df[df['category'] == cat]
    ax.plot(subset['date'], subset['value'], color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[i % len(PALETTE_CATEGORICAL)])
    ax.set_title(cat, fontsize=12)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Hide empty subplots
for j in range(i+1, len(axes)):
    axes[j].set_visible(False)

fig.suptitle('Trends by Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('small_multiples.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Number Formatting Helpers

```python
def format_number(val, format_type='number'):
    """Format numbers for chart labels."""
    if format_type == 'currency':
        if abs(val) >= 1e9:
            return f'${val/1e9:.1f}B'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e6:
            return f'${val/1e6:.1f}M'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e3:
            return f'${val/1e3:.1f}K'
        else:
            return f'${val:,.0f}'
    elif format_type == 'percent':
        return f'{val:.1f}%'
    elif format_type == 'number':
        if abs(val) >= 1e9:
            return f'{val/1e9:.1f}B'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e6:
            return f'{val/1e6:.1f}M'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e3:
            return f'{val/1e3:.1f}K'
        else:
            return f'{val:,.0f}'
    return str(val)

# Usage with axis formatter
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: format_number(x, 'currency')))
```

### Interactive Charts with Plotly

```python
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# Simple interactive line chart
fig = px.line(df, x='date', y='value', color='category',
              title='Interactive Metric Trend',
              labels={'value': 'Metric Value', 'date': 'Date'})
fig.update_layout(hovermode='x unified')
fig.write_html('interactive_chart.html')
fig.show()

# Interactive scatter with hover data
fig = px.scatter(df, x='metric_a', y='metric_b', color='category',
                 size='size_metric', hover_data=['name', 'detail_field'],
                 title='Correlation Analysis')
fig.show()
```

## Design Principles

### Color

- **Use color purposefully**: Color should encode data, not decorate
- **Highlight the story**: Use a bright accent color for the key insight; grey everything else
- **Sequential data**: Use a single-hue gradient (light to dark) for ordered values
- **Diverging data**: Use a two-hue gradient with neutral midpoint for data with a meaningful center
- **Categorical data**: Use distinct hues, maximum 6-8 before it gets confusing
- **Avoid red/green only**: 8% of men are red-green colorblind. Use blue/orange as primary pair

### Typography

- **Title states the insight**: "Revenue grew 23% YoY" beats "Revenue by Month"
- **Subtitle adds context**: Date range, filters applied, data source
- **Axis labels are readable**: Never rotated 90 degrees if avoidable. Shorten or wrap instead
- **Data labels add precision**: Use on key points, not every single bar
- **Annotation highlights**: Call out specific points with text annotations

### Layout

- **Reduce chart junk**: Remove gridlines, borders, backgrounds that don't carry information
- **Sort meaningfully**: Categories sorted by value (not alphabetically) unless there's a natural order (months, stages)
- **Appropriate aspect ratio**: Time series wider than tall (3:1 to 2:1); comparisons can be squarer
- **White space is good**: Don't cram charts together. Give each visualization room to breathe

### Accuracy

- **Bar charts start at zero**: Always. A bar from 95 to 100 exaggerates a 5% difference
- **Line charts can have non-zero baselines**: When the range of variation is meaningful
- **Consistent scales across panels**: When comparing multiple charts, use the same axis range
- **Show uncertainty**: Error bars, confidence intervals, or ranges when data is uncertain
- **Label your axes**: Never make the reader guess what the numbers mean

## Accessibility Considerations

### Color Blindness

- Never rely on color alone to distinguish data series
- Add pattern fills, different line styles (solid, dashed, dotted), or direct labels
- Test with a colorblind simulator (e.g., Coblis, Sim Daltonism)
- Use the colorblind-friendly palette: `sns.color_palette("colorblind")`

### Screen Readers

- Include alt text describing the chart's key finding
- Provide a data table alternative alongside the visualization
- Use semantic titles and labels

### General Accessibility

- Sufficient contrast between data elements and background
- Text size minimum 10pt for labels, 12pt for titles
- Avoid conveying information only through spatial position (add labels)
- Consider printing: does the chart work in black and white?

### Accessibility Checklist

Before sharing a visualization:
- [ ] Chart works without color (patterns, labels, or line styles differentiate series)
- [ ] Text is readable at standard zoom level
- [ ] Title describes the insight, not just the data
- [ ] Axes are labeled with units
- [ ] Legend is clear and positioned without obscuring data
- [ ] Data source and date range are noted

# Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 vs 2024 DALY Comparison

## Overview
This collection of datasets captures the global epidemiological transition between 1990 and 2024, covering top causes of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), disease burden composition by World Bank income group, and aggregate category totals.

## Data Source

### top10_daly_causes
Contains 20 rows (10 per year). Fields: `year` (1990 or 2024), `rank` (1–10), `cause` (disease/condition name, string), `dalys_millions` (float, millions of DALYs), `category` (one of: Communicable, NCD, Injury). Represents the top 10 global DALY causes for each reference year.

### daly_by_income_group
Contains 8 rows (4 income groups × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `income_group` (Low income, Lower-middle income, Upper-middle income, High income), `communicable_pct`, `ncd_pct`, `injury_pct` — each a float summing to approximately 100% per row. Represents percentage share of total DALYs by disease category within each income group.

### global_category_totals
Contains 6 rows (3 categories × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `category` (Communicable, NCD, Injury), `dalys_millions` (float). Represents aggregate global DALYs by broad disease category.

## Data Notes
- DALY estimates are modeled based on GBD-style methodology; 2024 figures are projected estimates.
- Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions per GBD convention.
- Percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.

2. **income-group-disparity**: Highlight differences in disease burden composition across income groups
3. **top-cause-rank-change**: Emphasize rank changes of top 10 DALY causes between 1990 and 2024
4. **communicable-vs-ncd-share**: Show aggregate communicable vs NCD vs injury share for each income group in both years
5. **encoding-mapping**: Use consistent color coding for Communicable, NCD, and Injury

This is a multi-panel visualization. I need to design a figure that:
- Shows the structural transition (global category totals 1990 vs 2024)
- Shows income group disparities (stacked bars or similar)
- Shows top cause rank changes (slope chart or dumbbell chart)
- Uses consistent color coding throughout

- **Panel B (top-right)**: Stacked percentage bars for income groups in both years, showing communicable/NCD/injury shares
- **Panel C (bottom, spanning)**: Slope chart or dumbbell chart showing rank changes of top 10 causes

For **income-group-disparity** (goal 2) and **communicable-vs-ncd-share** (goal 4): 100% stacked bars grouped by income group, with 1990 and 2024 side by side for each group. This shows both the composition and the differences across income groups.

For **top-cause-rank-change** (goal 3): A slope chart connecting the 1990 rank to the 2024 rank for each cause. This makes large rank shifts visually prominent.

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Consistent color mapping
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#3272AF',
    'NCD': '#E08040', 
    'Injury': '#5B9E4F'
}

# Style setup
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#CCCCCC',
    'axes.grid': False,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 14))

# ============================================
# Panel A: Global Category Totals (structural transition)
# ============================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)

global_data = data['global_category_totals']
years = [1990, 2024]
categories = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']

# Create stacked bars
x = np.arange(len(years))
width = 0.5
bottoms = np.zeros(len(years))

for cat in categories:
    vals = [d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['category'] == cat and d['year'] in years]
    vals_ordered = []
    for y in years:
        for d in global_data:
            if d['category'] == cat and d['year'] == y:
                vals_ordered.append(d['dalys_millions'])
    ax1.bar(x, vals_ordered, width, bottom=bottoms, label=cat, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    # Add value labels
    for i, v in enumerate(vals_ordered):
        ax1.text(x[i], bottoms[i] + v/2, f'{v:,.0f}M', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms += vals_ordered

# Add total labels on top
for i, y in enumerate(years):
    total = sum(d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == y)
    ax1.text(x[i], total + 30, f'{total:,.0f}M', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(years)
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('A. Global DALY Burden Shifted from Communicable\nto Non-Communicable Diseases', loc='left')
ax1.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.set_ylim(0, max(bottoms) * 1.12)

# ============================================
# Panel B: Income Group Composition (100% stacked bars)
# ============================================
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)

income_data = data['daly_by_income_group']
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']

x_positions = []
bar_labels = []
pos = 0

for ig in income_groups:
    for yr in [1990, 2024]:
        row = [d for d in income_data if d['income_group'] == ig and d['year'] == yr][0]
        bottom = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            ax2.bar(pos, val, 0.6, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
            if val > 8:
                ax2.text(pos, bottom + val/2, f'{val:.0f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color='white')
            bottom += val
        x_positions.append(pos)
        bar_labels.append(str(yr))
        pos += 1
    pos += 0.8  # gap between income groups

ax2.set_xticks(x_positions)
ax2.set_xticklabels(bar_labels, fontsize=8)

# Add income group labels
group_centers = []
pos = 0
for ig in income_groups:
    group_centers.append(pos + 0.5)
    pos += 2.8

# Actually let me recalculate...
# positions are 0, 1, gap, 2.8, 3.8, gap, 5.6, 6.6, gap, 8.4, 9.4
# centers: 0.5, 3.3, 6.1, 8.9

# Hmm, this is getting complicated. Let me redo with explicit positions.

# Let me redo Panel B with cleaner positioning
ax2.clear()

positions = []
labels_x = []
group_labels_added = False

# Position calculation
group_centers = []
pos = 0
all_positions = []

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    group_start = pos
    for j, yr in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
        row = [d for d in income_data if d['income_group'] == ig and d['year'] == yr][0]
        bottom = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            ax2.bar(pos, val, 0.55, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
            if val > 7:
                ax2.text(pos, bottom + val/2, f'{val:.0f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color='white')
            bottom += val
        all_positions.append(pos)
        pos += 1
    group_centers.append((group_start + pos - 1) / 2)
    pos += 0.7

ax2.set_xticks(all_positions)
ax2.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'] * 4, fontsize=8)
ax2.set_ylabel('Share of DALYs (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax2.set_title('B. Low-Income Countries Retain High Communicable Share\nWhile High-Income Countries Are NCD-Dominated', loc='left')

# Add income group labels below
for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    short_name = ig.replace(' income', '\nincome')
    ax2.text(group_centers[i], -8, short_name, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

# Add legend
handles = [plt.Rectangle((0,0), 1, 1, color=COLORS[c]) for c in categories]
ax2.legend(handles, categories, loc='upper right', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ============================================
# Panel C: Rank Changes (Slope Chart)
# ============================================
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 1, 2)

top10_data = data['top10_daly_causes']

# Get all unique causes
causes_1990 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 2024}

all_causes = list(dict.fromkeys(
    [d['cause'] for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 1990] +
    [d['cause'] for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 2024]
))

# For slope chart: rank 1 at top, so invert y-axis
# x-axis: 1990 on left, 2024 on right
# y-axis: rank (1 at top, 10 at bottom)
# Causes that don't appear in a year get rank 11

for cause in all_causes:
    cat = None
    rank_1990 = 11
    rank_2024 = 11
    
    if cause in causes_1990:
        rank_1990 = causes_1990[cause]['rank']
        cat = causes_1990[cause]['category']
    if cause in causes_2024:
        rank_2024 = causes_2024[cause]['rank']
        cat = causes_2024[cause]['category']
    
    color = COLORS.get(cat, '#888888')
    
    # Determine line thickness based on rank change
    rank_change = abs(rank_1990 - rank_2024)
    lw = 1.5 if rank_change <= 2 else 2.5
    
    alpha = 0.9 if rank_change > 2 else 0.5
    
    ax3.plot([0, 1], [rank_1990, rank_2024], color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=1)
    ax3.scatter([0], [rank_1990], color=color, s=40, zorder=2, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    ax3.scatter([1], [rank_2024], color=color, s=40, zorder=2, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    
    # Labels
    if cause in causes_1990:
        ax3.text(-0.02, rank_1990, cause, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8, color=color, fontweight='bold')
    else:
        ax3.text(-0.02, rank_1990, '', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8)
    
    if cause in causes_2024:
        ax3.text(1.02, rank_2024, cause, ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8, color=color, fontweight='bold')
    else:
        ax3.text(1.02, rank_2024, '', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8)

# For causes that dropped out or entered, add annotation
# Dropped out causes: show at rank 11 on 2024 side with arrow
# Entered causes: show at rank 11 on 1990 side with arrow

ax3.set_xlim(-0.35, 1.35)
ax3.set_ylim(11.5, 0.5)  # Invert so rank 1 is at top
ax3.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax3.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Rank')
ax3.set_yticks(range(1, 12))
ax3.set_yticklabels([str(i) for i in range(1, 10)] + ['10', 'Dropped out / Entered'])
ax3.set_title('C. Major Rank Shifts: Communicable Diseases Fell While NCDs Rose to Top', loc='left')
ax3.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['left'].set_visible(False)

# Add legend for colors
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Communicable'], label='Communicable'),
                   Patch(facecolor=COLORS['NCD'], label='NCD'),
                   Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injury')]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower right', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

plt.tight_layout(pad=2)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Consistent color mapping across all panels ──
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#3272AF',
    'NCD': '#E08040',
    'Injury': '#5B9E4F'
}
CATEGORIES = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']

# ── Style setup ──
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#999999',
    'axes.grid': False,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 16))

# ================================================================
# PANEL A: Global Category Totals — Structural Transition
# ================================================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)

global_data = data['global_category_totals']['data']
years = [1990, 2024]
x = np.arange(len(years))
width = 0.5
bottoms = np.zeros(len(years))

for cat in CATEGORIES:
    vals = []
    for yr in years:
        for d in global_data:
            if d['category'] == cat and d['year'] == yr:
                vals.append(d['dalys_millions'])
    bars = ax1.bar(x, vals, width, bottom=bottoms, label=cat,
                   color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        if v > 100:
            ax1.text(x[i], bottoms[i] + v / 2, f'{v:,.0f}M',
                     ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                     fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms += vals

# Totals on top
for i, yr in enumerate(years):
    total = sum(d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == yr)
    ax1.text(x[i], total + 30, f'Total: {total:,.0f}M',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(years, fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('A. Global DALY Burden Shifted from\nCommunicable to Non-Communicable Diseases', loc='left')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_ylim(0, max(bottoms) * 1.12)

# Annotation arrow showing shift
ax1.annotate('', xy=(1, 800), xytext=(0, 800),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#666666', lw=1.5))
ax1.text(0.5, 830, 'NCDs overtook\nCommunicable diseases',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, color='#666666', style='italic')

# ================================================================
# PANEL B: Income Group Composition — Communicable vs NCD vs Injury
# ================================================================
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)

income_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
short_names = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']

all_positions = []
group_centers = []
pos = 0

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    group_start = pos
    for j, yr in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
        row = [d for d in income_data if d['income_group'] == ig and d['year'] == yr][0]
        bottom = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            ax2.bar(pos, val, 0.55, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat],
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
            if val > 8:
                ax2.text(pos, bottom + val / 2, f'{val:.0f}%',
                         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
                         fontweight='bold', color='white')
            bottom += val
        all_positions.append(pos)
        pos += 1
    group_centers.append((group_start + pos - 1) / 2)
    pos += 0.8

ax2.set_xticks(all_positions)
ax2.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'] * 4, fontsize=7.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Share of DALYs (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)

# Income group labels
for i, sn in enumerate(short_names):
    ax2.text(group_centers[i], -9, sn, ha='center', va='top',
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold')

# Year bracket indicators
for i in range(4):
    start = all_positions[i * 2] - 0.35
    end = all_positions[i * 2 + 1] + 0.35
    center = group_centers[i]
    ax2.plot([start, end], [-4.5, -4.5], color='#999999', lw=0.8,
             transform=ax2.get_xaxis_transform(), clip_on=False)

ax2.set_title('B. Low-Income Countries Retain High Communicable\nShare While High-Income Are NCD-Dominated', loc='left')

handles = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=c) for c in CATEGORIES]
ax2.legend(handles=handles, loc='upper right', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)

# ================================================================
# PANEL C: Slope Chart — Top 10 Rank Changes
# ================================================================
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 1, 2)

top10_data = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']
causes_1990 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 2024}

# All unique causes in order: 1990 top-10 then 2024-only entrants
all_causes_1990 = [d['cause'] for d in sorted(top10_data, key=lambda x: (x['year'], x['rank'])) if d['year'] == 1990]
all_causes_2024_only = [d['cause'] for d in sorted(top10_data, key=lambda x: (x['year'], x['rank'])) if d['year'] == 2024 and d['cause'] not in causes_1990]
all_causes = all_causes_1990 + all_causes_2024_only

# Helper to get category color
def get_category(cause):
    if cause in causes_1990:
        return causes_1990[cause]['category']
    if cause in causes_2024:
        return causes_2024[cause]['category']
    return 'Injury'

# Draw slope lines
for cause in all_causes:
    cat = get_category(cause)
    color = COLORS[cat]

    in_1990 = cause in causes_1990
    in_2024 = cause in causes_2024

    rank_1990 = causes_1990[cause]['rank'] if in_1990 else 11.5
    rank_2024 = causes_2024[cause]['rank'] if in_2024 else 11.5

    rank_change = abs(rank_1990 - rank_2024)

    # Visual prominence based on rank shift
    if rank_change >= 5:
        lw, alpha = 2.8, 0.95
    elif rank_change >= 3:
        lw, alpha = 2.2, 0.85
    elif rank_change >= 1:
        lw, alpha = 1.6, 0.6
    else:
        lw, alpha = 1.2, 0.45

    if in_1990 and in_2024:
        ax3.plot([0, 1], [rank_1990, rank_2024], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=1, solid_capstyle='round')
        ax3.scatter([0], [rank_1990], color=color, s=50, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
        ax3.scatter([1], [rank_2024], color=color, s=50, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
    elif in_1990 and not in_2024:
        # Dropped out — line fades to right
        ax3.plot([0, 0.65], [rank_1990, 11.2], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw * 0.7, alpha=0.4, linestyle='--', zorder=1)
        ax3.scatter([0], [rank_1990], color=color, s=50, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
        ax3.scatter([0.65], [11.2], color=color, s=30, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)
    elif not in_1990 and in_2024:
        # Entered — line fades in from left
        ax3.plot([0.35, 1], [11.2, rank_2024], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw * 0.7, alpha=0.4, linestyle='--', zorder=1)
        ax3.scatter([0.35], [11.2], color=color, s=30, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)
        ax3.scatter([1], [rank_2024], color=color, s=50, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)

# Labels on 1990 side
for cause in all_causes:
    cat = get_category(cause)
    color = COLORS[cat]
    if cause in causes_1990:
        r = causes_1990[cause]['rank']
        ax3.text(-0.03, r, cause, ha='right', va='center',
                 fontsize=8, color=color, fontweight='bold')
    else:
        pass  # entered labels on right side only

# Labels on 2024 side
for cause in all_causes:
    cat = get_category(cause)
    color = COLORS[cat]
    if cause in causes_2024:
        r = causes_2024[cause]['rank']
        ax3.text(1.03, r, cause, ha='left', va='center',
                 fontsize=8, color=color, fontweight='bold')

# Dropped-out annotation on right side
dropped = [c for c in all_causes if c in causes_1990 and c not in causes_2024]
if dropped:
    ax3.text(0.65, 11.7, 'Exited top 10', ha='center', va='bottom',
             fontsize=7, color='#888888', style='italic')

# Entered annotation on left side
entered = [c for c in all_causes if c not in causes_1990 and c in causes_2024]
if entered:
    ax3.text(0.35, 11.7, 'Entered top 10', ha='center', va='bottom',
             fontsize=7, color='#888888', style='italic')

# Key shift annotations
# Ischemic heart disease: 4 → 1
ax3.annotate('Rose to #1\n(+3 ranks)', xy=(0.5, 2.5),
             fontsize=7, ha='center', color=COLORS['NCD'],
             fontweight='bold', style='italic',

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Consistent color mapping across all panels ──
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#3272AF',
    'NCD': '#E08040',
    'Injury': '#5B9E4F'
}
CATEGORIES = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']

# ── Style setup ──
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#999999',
    'axes.grid': False,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 16))

# ================================================================
# PANEL A: Global Category Totals — Structural Transition
# ================================================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)

global_data = data['global_category_totals']['data']
years = [1990, 2024]
x = np.arange(len(years))
width = 0.5
bottoms = np.zeros(len(years))

for cat in CATEGORIES:
    vals = []
    for yr in years:
        for d in global_data:
            if d['category'] == cat and d['year'] == yr:
                vals.append(d['dalys_millions'])
    bars = ax1.bar(x, vals, width, bottom=bottoms, label=cat,
                   color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        if v > 100:
            ax1.text(x[i], bottoms[i] + v / 2, f'{v:,.0f}M',
                     ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                     fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms += vals

# Totals on top
for i, yr in enumerate(years):
    total = sum(d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == yr)
    ax1.text(x[i], total + 30, f'Total: {total:,.0f}M',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(years, fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('A. Global DALY Burden Shifted from\nCommunicable to Non-Communicable Diseases', loc='left')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_ylim(0, max(bottoms) * 1.12)

# Annotation arrow showing shift
ax1.annotate('', xy=(1, 800), xytext=(0, 800),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#666666', lw=1.5))
ax1.text(0.5, 830, 'NCDs overtook\nCommunicable diseases',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, color='#666666', style='italic')

# ================================================================
# PANEL B: Income Group Composition — Communicable vs NCD vs Injury
# ================================================================
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)

income_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
short_names = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']

all_positions = []
group_centers = []
pos = 0

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    group_start = pos
    for j, yr in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
        row = [d for d in income_data if d['income_group'] == ig and d['year'] == yr][0]
        bottom = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            ax2.bar(pos, val, 0.55, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat],
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
            if val > 8:
                ax2.text(pos, bottom + val / 2, f'{val:.0f}%',
                         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
                         fontweight='bold', color='white')
            bottom += val
        all_positions.append(pos)
        pos += 1
    group_centers.append((group_start + pos - 1) / 2)
    pos += 0.8

ax2.set_xticks(all_positions)
ax2.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'] * 4, fontsize=7.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Share of DALYs (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)

# Income group labels
for i, sn in enumerate(short_names):
    ax2.text(group_centers[i], -9, sn, ha='center', va='top',
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold')

# Year bracket indicators
for i in range(4):
    start = all_positions[i * 2] - 0.35
    end = all_positions[i * 2 + 1] + 0.35
    center = group_centers[i]
    ax2.plot([start, end], [-4.5, -4.5], color='#999999', lw=0.8,
             transform=ax2.get_xaxis_transform(), clip_on=False)

ax2.set_title('B. Low-Income Countries Retain High Communicable\nShare While High-Income Are NCD-Dominated', loc='left')

handles = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=c) for c in CATEGORIES]
ax2.legend(handles=handles, loc='upper right', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)

# ================================================================
# PANEL C: Slope Chart — Top 10 Rank Changes
# ================================================================
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 1, 2)

top10_data = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']
causes_1990 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 2024}

# All unique causes in order: 1990 top-10 then 2024-only entrants
all_causes_1990 = [d['cause'] for d in sorted(top10_data, key=lambda x: (x['year'], x['rank'])) if d['year'] == 1990]
all_causes_2024_only = [d['cause'] for d in sorted(top10_data, key=lambda x: (x['year'], x['rank'])) if d['year'] == 2024 and d['cause'] not in causes_1990]
all_causes = all_causes_1990 + all_causes_2024_only

# Helper to get category color
def get_category(cause):
    if cause in causes_1990:
        return causes_1990[cause]['category']
    if cause in causes_2024:
        return causes_2024[cause]['category']
    return 'Injury'

# Draw slope lines
for cause in all_causes:
    cat = get_category(cause)
    color = COLORS[cat]

    in_1990 = cause in causes_1990
    in_2024 = cause in causes_2024

    rank_1990 = causes_1990[cause]['rank'] if in_1990 else 11.5
    rank_2024 = causes_2024[cause]['rank'] if in_2024 else 11.5

    rank_change = abs(rank_1990 - rank_2024)

    # Visual prominence based on rank shift
    if rank_change >= 5:
        lw, alpha = 2.8, 0.95
    elif rank_change >= 3:
        lw, alpha = 2.2, 0.85
    elif rank_change >= 1:
        lw, alpha = 1.6, 0.6
    else:
        lw, alpha = 1.2, 0.45

    if in_1990 and in_2024:
        ax3.plot([0, 1], [rank_1990, rank_2024], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=1, solid_capstyle='round')
        ax3.scatter([0], [rank_1990], color=color, s=50, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
        ax3.scatter([1], [rank_2024], color=color, s=50, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
    elif in_1990 and not in_2024:
        # Dropped out — line fades to right
        ax3.plot([0, 0.65], [rank_1990, 11.2], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw * 0.7, alpha=0.4, linestyle='--', zorder=1)
        ax3.scatter([0], [rank_1990], color=color, s=50, zorder=3,

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Consistent color mapping across all panels ──
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#3272AF',
    'NCD': '#E08040',
    'Injury': '#5B9E4F'
}
CATEGORIES = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']

# ── Style setup ──
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#999999',
    'axes.grid': False,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 16))

# ================================================================
# PANEL A: Global Category Totals — Structural Transition
# ================================================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)

global_data = data['global_category_totals']['data']
years = [1990, 2024]
x = np.arange(len(years))
width = 0.5
bottoms = np.zeros(len(years))

for cat in CATEGORIES:
    vals = []
    for yr in years:
        for d in global_data:
            if d['category'] == cat and d['year'] == yr:
                vals.append(d['dalys_millions'])
    ax1.bar(x, vals, width, bottom=bottoms, label=cat,
            color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        if v > 100:
            ax1.text(x[i], bottoms[i] + v / 2, f'{v:,.0f}M',
                     ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                     fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms += vals

# Totals on top
for i, yr in enumerate(years):
    total = sum(d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == yr)
    ax1.text(x[i], total + 40, f'Total: {total:,.0f}M',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(years, fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('A. Global DALY Burden Shifted from\nCommunicable to Non-Communicable Diseases', loc='left')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_ylim(0, max(bottoms) * 1.15)

# Highlight the crossover
total_1990_comm = [d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == 1990 and d['category'] == 'Communicable'][0]
total_2024_ncd = [d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == 2024 and d['category'] == 'NCD'][0]
ax1.annotate('NCDs overtook\nCommunicable diseases',
             xy=(0.5, (total_1990_comm + total_2024_ncd) / 2),
             fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color='#555555', style='italic',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white',
                       edgecolor='#CCCCCC', alpha=0.9))

ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ================================================================
# PANEL B: Income Group Composition — Communicable vs NCD vs Injury
# ================================================================
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)

income_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
short_names = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']

all_positions = []
group_centers = []
pos = 0

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    group_start = pos
    for j, yr in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
        row = [d for d in income_data if d['income_group'] == ig and d['year'] == yr][0]
        bottom = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            ax2.bar(pos, val, 0.55, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat],
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
            if val > 7:
                ax2.text(pos, bottom + val / 2, f'{val:.0f}%',
                         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                         fontweight='bold', color='white')
            bottom += val
        all_positions.append(pos)
        pos += 1
    group_centers.append((group_start + pos - 1) / 2)
    pos += 0.8

ax2.set_xticks(all_positions)
ax2.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'] * 4, fontsize=7.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Share of DALYs (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(-12, 105)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Consistent color mapping across all panels ──
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#3272AF',
    'NCD': '#E08040',
    'Injury': '#5B9E4F'
}
CATEGORIES = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']

# ── Style setup ──
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#999999',
    'axes.grid': False,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 16))

# ================================================================
# PANEL A: Global Category Totals — Structural Transition
# ================================================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)

global_data = data['global_category_totals']['data']
years = [1990, 2024]
x = np.arange(len(years))
width = 0.5
bottoms = np.zeros(len(years))

for cat in CATEGORIES:
    vals = []
    for yr in years:
        for d in global_data:
            if d['category'] == cat and d['year'] == yr:
                vals.append(d['dalys_millions'])
    ax1.bar(x, vals, width, bottom=bottoms, label=cat,
            color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        if v > 100:
            ax1.text(x[i], bottoms[i] + v / 2, f'{v:,.0f}M',
                     ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                     fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms += vals

# Totals on top
for i, yr in enumerate(years):
    total = sum(d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == yr)
    ax1.text(x[i], total + 40, f'Total: {total:,.0f}M',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(years, fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('A. Global DALY Burden Shifted from\nCommunicable to Non-Communicable Diseases', loc='left')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_ylim(0, max(bottoms) * 1.15)

# Highlight the crossover
total_1990_comm = [d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == 1990 and d['category'] == 'Communicable'][0]
total_2024_ncd = [d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == 2024 and d['category'] == 'NCD'][0]
ax1.annotate('NCDs overtook\nCommunicable diseases',
             xy=(0.5, (total_1990_comm + total_2024_ncd) / 2),
             fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color='#555555', style='italic',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white',
                       edgecolor='#CCCCCC', alpha=0.9))

ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ================================================================
# PANEL B: Income Group Composition — Communicable vs NCD vs Injury
# ================================================================
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)

income_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
short_names = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']

all_positions = []
group_centers = []
pos = 0

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    group_start = pos
    for j, yr in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
        row = [d for d in income_data if d['income_group'] == ig and d['year'] == yr][0]
        bottom = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            ax2.bar(pos, val, 0.55, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat],
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
            if val > 7:
                ax2.text(pos, bottom + val / 2, f'{val:.0f}%',
                         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                         fontweight='bold', color='white')
            bottom += val
        all_positions.append(pos)
        pos += 1
    group_centers.append((group_start + pos - 1) / 2)
    pos += 0.8

ax2.set_xticks(all_positions)
ax2.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'] * 4, fontsize=7.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Share of DALYs (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(-12, 105)

# Income group labels below bars
for i, sn in enumerate(short_names):
    ax2.text(group_centers[i], -6, sn, ha='center', va='top',
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', clip_on=False)

# Bracket lines under each group
for i in range(4):
    start = all_positions[i * 2] - 0.35
    end = all_positions[i * 2 + 1] + 0.35
    ax2.plot([start, end], [-3.5, -3.5], color='#999999', lw=0.8, clip_on=False)

ax2.set_title('B. Low-Income Countries Retain High Communicable\nShare While High-Income Are NCD-Dominated', loc='left')

handles = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=c) for c in CATEGORIES]
ax2.legend(handles=handles, loc='upper right', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ================================================================
# PANEL C: Slope Chart — Top 10 Rank Changes
# ================================================================
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 1, 2)

top10_data = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']
causes_1990 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 2024}

# All unique causes: 1990 top-10 then 2024-only entrants
all_causes_1990 = [d['cause'] for d in sorted(
    [d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 1990], key=lambda x: x['rank'])]
all_causes_2024_only = [d['cause'] for d in sorted(
    [d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 2024 and d['cause'] not in causes_1990],
    key=lambda x: x['rank'])]
all_causes = all_causes_1990 + all_causes_2024_only

def get_category(cause):
    if cause in causes_1990:
        return causes_1990[cause]['category']
    if cause in causes_2024:
        return causes_2024[cause]['category']
    return 'Injury'

# Draw slope lines
for cause in all_causes:
    cat = get_category(cause)
    color = COLORS[cat]

    in_1990 = cause in causes_1990
    in_2024 = cause in causes_2024

    rank_1990 = causes_1990[cause]['rank'] if in_1990 else 11.5
    rank_2024 = causes_2024[cause]['rank'] if in_2024 else 11.5
    rank_change = abs(rank_1990 - rank_2024)

    # Visual prominence based on rank shift magnitude
    if rank_change >= 5:
        lw, alpha = 2.8, 0.95
    elif rank_change >= 3:
        lw, alpha = 2.2, 0.85
    elif rank_change >= 1:
        lw, alpha = 1.5, 0.55
    else:
        lw, alpha = 1.2, 0.4

    if in_1990 and in_2024:
        ax3.plot([0, 1], [rank_1990, rank_2024], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=1, solid_capstyle='round')
        ax3.scatter([0], [rank_1990], color=color, s=55, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
        ax3.scatter([1], [rank_2024], color=color, s=55, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
    elif in_1990 and not in_2024:
        ax3.plot([0, 0.6], [rank_1990, 11.0], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw * 0.6, alpha=0.35, linestyle='--', zorder=1)

            color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        if v > 100:

                     ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                     fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms += vals

# Totals on top
for i, yr in enumerate(years):

ax1.annotate('NCDs overtook\nCommunicable diseases',
             xy=(0.5, (total_1990_comm + total_2024_ncd) / 2),
             fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color='#555555', style='italic',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white',
                       edgecolor='#CCCCCC', alpha=0.9))

ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

short_names = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']

all_positions = []

pos = 0

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    group_start = pos
    for j, yr in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
        row = [d for d in income_data if d['income_group'] == ig and d['year'] == yr][0]
        bottom = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            ax2.bar(pos, val, 0.55, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat],
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
            if val > 7:
                ax2.text(pos, bottom + val / 2, f'{val:.0f}%',
                         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                         fontweight='bold', color='white')
            bottom += val
        all_positions.append(pos)
        pos += 1
    group_centers.append((group_start + pos - 1) / 2)
    pos += 0.8

ax2.set_xticks(all_positions)

ax2.set_ylabel('Share of DALYs (%)')

x = np.arange(len(years))
width = 0.5
bottoms = np.zeros(len(years))

for cat in CATEGORIES:
    vals = []
    for yr in years:
        for d in global_data:
            if d['category'] == cat and d['year'] == yr:
                vals.append(d['dalys_millions'])
    ax1.bar(x, vals, width, bottom=bottoms, label=cat,
            color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        if v > 100:
            ax1.text(x[i], bottoms[i] + v / 2, f'{v:,.0f}M',
                     ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                     fontweight='bold', color='white')
    bottoms += vals

# Totals on top
for i, yr in enumerate(years):
    total = sum(d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == yr)
    ax1.text(x[i], total + 40, f'Total: {total:,.0f}M',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(years, fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_title('A. Global DALY Burden Shifted from\nCommunicable to Non-Communicable Diseases', loc='left')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_ylim(0, max(bottoms) * 1.15)

# Highlight the crossover
total_1990_comm = [d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == 1990 and d['category'] == 'Communicable'][0]
total_2024_ncd = [d['dalys_millions'] for d in global_data if d['year'] == 2024 and d['category'] == 'NCD'][0]
ax1.annotate('NCDs overtook\nCommunicable diseases',
             xy=(0.5, (total_1990_comm + total_2024_ncd) / 2),
             fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color='#555555', style='italic',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white',
                       edgecolor='#CCCCCC', alpha=0.9))

ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ================================================================
# PANEL B: Income Group Composition — Communicable vs NCD vs Injury
# ================================================================
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)

income_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
short_names = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']

all_positions = []
group_centers = []
pos = 0

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    group_start = pos
    for j, yr in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
        row = [d for d in income_data if d['income_group'] == ig and d['year'] == yr][0]
        bottom = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            ax2.bar(pos, val, 0.55, bottom=bottom, color=COLORS[cat],
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
            if val > 7:
                ax2.text(pos, bottom + val / 2, f'{val:.0f}%',
                         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                         fontweight='bold', color='white')
            bottom += val
        all_positions.append(pos)
        pos += 1
    group_centers.append((group_start + pos - 1) / 2)
    pos += 0.8

ax2.set_xticks(all_positions)
ax2.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'] * 4, fontsize=7.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Share of DALYs (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(-12, 105)

# Income group labels below bars
for i, sn in enumerate(short_names):
    ax2.text(group_centers[i], -6, sn, ha='center', va='top',
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', clip_on=False)

# Bracket lines under each group
for i in range(4):
    start = all_positions[i * 2] - 0.35
    end = all_positions[i * 2 + 1] + 0.35
    ax2.plot([start, end], [-3.5, -3.5], color='#999999', lw=0.8, clip_on=False)

ax2.set_title('B. Low-Income Countries Retain High Communicable\nShare While High-Income Are NCD-Dominated', loc='left')

handles = [mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS[c], label=c) for c in CATEGORIES]
ax2.legend(handles=handles, loc='upper right', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ================================================================
# PANEL C: Slope Chart — Top 10 Rank Changes
# ================================================================
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 1, 2)

top10_data = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']
causes_1990 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {d['cause']: d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 2024}

# All unique causes: 1990 top-10 then 2024-only entrants
all_causes_1990 = [d['cause'] for d in sorted(
    [d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 1990], key=lambda x: x['rank'])]
all_causes_2024_only = [d['cause'] for d in sorted(
    [d for d in top10_data if d['year'] == 2024 and d['cause'] not in causes_1990],
    key=lambda x: x['rank'])]
all_causes = all_causes_1990 + all_causes_2024_only

def get_category(cause):
    if cause in causes_1990:
        return causes_1990[cause]['category']
    if cause in causes_2024:
        return causes_2024[cause]['category']
    return 'Injury'

# Draw slope lines
for cause in all_causes:
    cat = get_category(cause)
    color = COLORS[cat]

    in_1990 = cause in causes_1990
    in_2024 = cause in causes_2024

    rank_1990 = causes_1990[cause]['rank'] if in_1990 else 11.5
    rank_2024 = causes_2024[cause]['rank'] if in_2024 else 11.5
    rank_change = abs(rank_1990 - rank_2024)

    # Visual prominence based on rank shift magnitude
    if rank_change >= 5:
        lw, alpha = 2.8, 0.95
    elif rank_change >= 3:
        lw, alpha = 2.2, 0.85
    elif rank_change >= 1:
        lw, alpha = 1.5, 0.55
    else:
        lw, alpha = 1.2, 0.4

    if in_1990 and in_2024:
        ax3.plot([0, 1], [rank_1990, rank_2024], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=1, solid_capstyle='round')
        ax3.scatter([0], [rank_1990], color=color, s=55, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
        ax3.scatter([1], [rank_2024], color=color, s=55, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
    elif in_1990 and not in_2024:
        ax3.plot([0, 0.6], [rank_1990, 11.0], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw * 0.6, alpha=0.35, linestyle='--', zorder=1)
        ax3.scatter([0], [rank_1990], color=color, s=55, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
        ax3.scatter([0.6], [11.0], color=color, s=25, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.4)
    elif not in_1990 and in_2024:
        ax3.plot([0.4, 1], [11.0, rank_2024], color=color,
                 linewidth=lw * 0.6, alpha=0.35, linestyle='--', zorder=1)
        ax3.scatter([0.4], [11.0], color=color, s=25, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.4)
        ax3.scatter([1], [rank_2024], color=color, s=55, zorder=3,
                    edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)

# Labels on 1990 side
for cause in all_causes:
    if cause in causes_1990:
        cat = causes_1990[cause]['category']
        r = causes_1990[cause]['rank']
        ax3.text(-0.03, r, cause, ha='right', va='center',
                 fontsize=8, color=COLORS[cat], fontweight='bold')

# Labels on 2024 side
for cause in all_causes:
    if cause in causes_2024:
        cat = causes_2024[cause]['category']
        r = causes_2024[cause]['rank']
        ax3.text(1.03, r, cause, ha='left', va='center',
                 fontsize=8, color=COLORS[cat], fontweight='bold')

# Dropped-out / Entered annotations
ax3.text(0.6, 11.5, 'Exited top 10', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=7, color='#888888', style='italic')
ax3.text(0.4, 11.5, 'Entered top 10', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=7, color='#888888', style='italic')

# Highlight key shifts with callout annotations
# Ischemic heart disease: 4 → 1 (big rise)
ax3.annotate('Ischemic heart disease\nrose 4 → 1',
             xy=(0.5, 2.0), xytext=(0.5, 1.2),
             fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color=COLORS['NCD'],
             fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLORS['NCD'], lw=1),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFF3E0',
                       edgecolor=COLORS['NCD'], alpha=0.85))

# Lower respiratory infections: 1 → 6 (big drop)
ax3.annotate('Lower resp. infections\nfell 1 → 6',
             xy=(0.5, 4.0), xytext=(0.38, 4.8),
             fontsize=7.5, ha='center', color=COLORS['Communicable'],
             fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLORS['Communicable'], lw=1),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#E3F2FD',
                       edgecolor=COLORS['Communicable'], alpha=0.85))

ax3.set_xlim(-0.45, 1.45)
ax3.set_ylim(12.5, 0.5)  # Rank 1 at top
ax3.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax3.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Rank (top 10 global DALY causes)')
ax3.set_yticks(range(1, 11))
ax3.set_yticklabels([f'#{i}' for i in range(1, 11)], fontsize=8)
ax3.set_title('C. Major Rank Shifts: Communicable Diseases Fell While NCDs Rose to the Top',
              loc='left', pad=12)

# Light horizontal gridlines at each rank
for r in range(1, 11):
    ax3.axhline(r, color='#E8E8E8', linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)

# Legend
legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Communicable'], label='Communicable'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['NCD'], label='NCD'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injury'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='#888888', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='--',
               label='Exited / Entered top 10')
]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower left', frameon=True,
           edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=8, ncol=4)
ax3.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# ── Final layout ──
plt.tight_layout(pad=2.5, h_pad=3.5)

# Source note
fig.text(0.5, 0.005,
         'Source: GBD-style modeled estimates; 2024 figures are projected. '
         'Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions.',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', style='italic')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
